problem.title: Coin Change - Minimum Coins
problem.problemStatement: Given coin denominations and a target amount, determine the minimum number of coins required to form the target amount. If impossible, print -1.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and Amount. • Second line contains N coin denominations.
problem.output: Print the minimum number of coins.
